Dental Implants at Clearwater, FL

BOOK NOW

What Are Dental Implants

Are missing teeth interfering with your daily life, from smiling to enjoying certain foods? Clearwater Dentist offers a premier solution for your oral health: lifelike and permanent dental implants. Implants serve as replacement teeth that closely resemble both appearance and functionality of natural ones. Furthermore, there is no need to remove or extract these replacements! These are so natural and, with proper care, can even last a lifetime.

Your Choice of Materials: Titanium & Biocompatible Zirconia

﻿At our practice, we believe in providing options that suit your specific health needs and aesthetic goals. We specialize in using high-quality dental implants in two primary materials:

  • Traditional Titanium: The industry gold standard, known for its incredible strength, durability, and long-term track record of successful bone integration.
  • SDS Zirconia (Ceramic) Implants: For patients seeking a holistic, metal-free alternative, we are proud to offer zirconia implants from Swiss Dental Solutions (SDS). These ceramic implants are 100% biocompatible, hypoallergenic, and naturally tooth-colored—eliminating the risk of dark metal margins at the gumline and promoting superior soft-tissue health.

Dental Implants Restore Your Lifestyle

Dental implants can transform your life, offering benefits that extend beyond tooth replacement. You can smile with confidence, without fear or reluctance, because your teeth will look and feel like natural teeth. You can now express yourself with confidence in social and professional situations. It allows you to eat the foods that you enjoy without restriction. Implants provide stability and strength to chew and bite comfortably, unlike removable dentures. Dental implants let you enjoy every bite, whether it is crunchy vegetables and fruits or chewy steaks.

  • Read More

    Dental implants can also help you speak clearly. Speech clarity can be affected by missing teeth or poorly fitting dentures, which may cause slurring and mumbling. You can communicate more clearly with implants. This will boost your confidence and improve communication.


    Dental implants also have a profound emotional impact. It is important to feel pride and self-respect in your appearance. This will improve your overall health.It  restores not only your smile, but also your self-worth and dignity. You can now face the world in a positive and confident manner.


    Dental implants are important for maintaining oral health. They not only provide aesthetics but also confidence. Implants prevent teeth from shifting and tilting by filling the gaps left behind by missing teeth. This maintains proper dental alignment. Misaligned teeth can cause issues like jaw pain, tooth decay, or gum disease.


    Dental implants restore not only your smile, but also your life style. You can smile with confidence, eat your favorite foods and feel confident. Reclaim your life with dental implants.

Planning and Preparation

Before embarking on our dental implant journey, we take great care to conduct a detailed consultation to gain a full understanding of your desires, needs, and aesthetic aspirations. Through this process we assess oral health using advanced technology like cone beam CT scanners; additionally we may perform extractions as necessary to address failing teeth.

 

Individuals who have suffered tooth loss over time may notice a gradual reduction in jaw bone volume, as this provides essential support for dental implant placement. To address bone loss, we offer bone graft procedures: by adding new bone material directly into affected areas and fostering healing and fusion with existing bones, bone graft procedures help restore proper levels of support needed to support new dental implants successfully.

Surgery And Restoration

Dr. Pokrovskaya can use Halcion during dental implant surgeries for those needing multiple implants or with severe dental anxiety to help ensure a comfortable experience. Following Halcion, biocompatible posts will be placed into predetermined areas in their jaw to act as replacements for missing teeth.

 

Implant posts serve as artificial tooth roots, stimulating jawbone growth while simultaneously anchoring new teeth securely into place. We may even provide temporary crown attachment on the same day to make sure you never go without one!

 

After giving your implant time to heal for several months, we complete its treatment with a permanent, natural-looking crown that restores natural mouth function and provides you with a healthy smile again.

The Most Natural Solution To Missing Teeth

Dentures are not the best option for replacing missing teeth permanently. Dental implants provide a superior alternative. Dental implants not only give you a natural smile, but they also work like real teeth! You must maintain good oral hygiene, such as brushing, flossing, and maintaining the gums, just like with natural teeth. However, your implants will not cause you any discomfort or cavities!


Furthermore, dental implants provide several advantages over traditional dentures. Implants are anchored securely into the jawbone and provide stability, preventing embarrassing moments when eating or speaking. This stability allows you to chew more naturally, which will allow you to eat a variety of food without restriction.

  • Read More

    Dental implants also contribute to maintaining the jawbone's structure. The jawbone may deteriorate due to lack stimulation when teeth are missing. Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing bone loss. It not only helps maintain facial aesthetics, but also promotes overall oral health.


    You can expect your implants, bridges and dentures to last the rest of their lives with proper care, regular checkups at our office, and regular maintenance. Our team will provide you with personalized care to ensure that your dental restorations are functional and long-lasting. Dental implants are not only a long-term investment, but they also provide you with comfort, confidence and a beautiful, healthy smile.


    Do not hesitate to discover the benefits of dental implant restoration and improve your quality of life. Call us to schedule a consultation and begin your journey towards a healthier, happier, and more confident life.

Benefits of Dental Implants at Clearwater Dentist

Clearwater Dentist is dedicated to providing the best dental care available, including dental implants. Read on for more information.

  • Natural Feel and Look

    Dental implants are made to look and feel like your natural teeth. Each implant is made to match your natural teeth perfectly, creating a realistic appearance. You can smile, eat, and speak confidently, knowing that the dental implants look and feel like your natural teeth.


  • Improved Oral Care

    Dental implants differ from traditional bridges because they do not alter the adjacent teeth. Implants improve oral health by preserving the integrity and strength of adjacent teeth. Implants also make it easier to keep your mouth clean, which reduces the risk of gum disease and cavities.


  • Enhanced Comfort and Convenience

    Dental implants can eliminate the discomfort that comes with removable dentures. Because they are permanently attached, implants function like natural teeth. No more worries about dentures sliding or causing sores. Enjoy your favorite foods, activities, and sports without discomfort or restrictions.


  • Durability

    Dental implants can last for a lifetime if they are properly cared for. They are a more cost-effective solution than other options for tooth replacement that require frequent replacements or repairs. Dental implants are made of high-quality materials such as titanium which is biocompatible and resistant against decay.


  • Bone Preservation

    Dental implants have the ability to maintain and stimulate jawbone density. The bone that supported a missing tooth begins to deteriorate. Dental implants are artificial tooth roots that stimulate the bone to prevent loss. This support preserves your facial structure, preventing the sunken appearance that can result from prolonged tooth loss.


  • Improved Speech

    Uncomfortable dentures can cause embarrassing slurred or mumbled speech. Dental implants offer a stable, secure fit that allows you to speak confidently and clearly without worrying about your teeth shifting.


  • Self-Esteem Boost

    A healthy and complete smile can boost self-esteem. Dental implants can restore the natural beauty of your smile, giving you more confidence in professional and social interactions. Knowing that you have a beautiful smile can improve your mental and physical well-being.


  • Easy Maintenance

    Dental implants are easy to maintain. They can be brushed and flossed like natural teeth without special adhesives or cleaning products. You only need to maintain good oral hygiene and regular dental visits to keep your implants looking great.


  • Stable and Secure Fit

    Unlike dentures that can shift or move, dental implants are securely anchored into your jawbone. Thanks to the stable fit, you can enjoy your favorite foods with no worries. You can now eat all your favorite foods, even the ones that are hard, crunchy, or sticky.


  • Versatile and Customizable

    Dental implants can be customized and are versatile. They are therefore suitable for a wide range of dental restorations. Implants can be customized to fit your needs, whether you need to replace a single missing tooth, several teeth, or an entire arch. The implants can support crowns, dentures, and bridges.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does the dental implant procedure take?

Most dental implants can be placed in minutes, but they need to solidify in the bone before putting a tooth on it. This usually require 3-6 months of healing between the initial installation and the final permanent crown. 

How Much Do Dental Implants Cost?

Dental implants cost thousands of dollars for each implant.

Is dental implant surgery painful?

Dental implants should never be painful. If the area is fully numbed, and the dentist is trained and skilled in dental implants, the procedure will not be painful.

Are there financing options available for dental implants?

Yes, at Clearwater Dentist we have many financing options for patients, many with 0% APR for up to 2 years, and with low APR up to 7 years. We have financing options for every budget.

Can dental implants be placed on the same day as tooth extraction?

Yes, in many cases an implant can be placed at the time of extraction.

How long is the recovery time after getting dental implants?

In most cases, the patient is back to normal within one day of the surgery. 

What can I expect during the dental implant healing process?

Most of the time the process of healing after an implant placement is very quick and painless, and complications after implant surgery are rare.
